Synopsis:
BNY delivered a record Q2 2026, with revenue up 13% YoY to $5.7B, EPS of $2.46 beating estimates by $0.24, and net interest income surging 20%. The bank raised its full-year revenue growth guidance to 10–11% (vs. prior ~5%, vs. consensus 7.8%), citing buoyant equity markets, strong fee income, rising AuC/AuM, and robust client activity. CEO Vince struck a constructive tone on corporate earnings and market valuations. CFO flagged potential H2 slowdown as a known risk but noted strategic buffer ("white space"). BNY shares +33% YTD.
